entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A flat measure of weight in effect or meaning, asserting that something counts without saying the counting is welcome.
examples: a significant change in tax laws
a significant change in the Constitution

entries.definition: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same global reach as *earthshaking*, with the world named outright instead of shaken underfoot.
examples: the contest was no world-shaking affair

entries.definition: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most violent of the three: the world does not shake but breaks, so the significance arrives as rupture.
examples: the conversation … could hardly be called world-shattering

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and exuberant - a hit rather than a result, success that arrives with applause attached.
examples: for years he was a boffo box office certainty

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Profit heard as noise, busy enough to be audible, where *flourishing* keeps its liveliness quiet.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Swelling growth caught mid-expansion, promising more where *prosperous* implies arrival.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Liveliness figured as healthy growth, organic where *booming* is loud.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely positional - it records that the office is held and passes no judgement on the holding.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Blunt finality: the success is banked and out of doubt, unlike *sure-fire*, which is confident about what has yet to happen.
examples: now I am a made man forever

entries.definition: of a game (or the pitching) in which a pitcher allows the opponent no hits
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A technical description of what the pitching allowed, recording the fact where the rest of the family evaluates.
examples: The visiting pitcher no-hit the home team today
The home team no-hit the visiting team last week

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Ornate and faintly grand, giving profitable liveliness a costume that *thriving* does without.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measured, almost accounting approval - results were yielded, with none of *boffo*'s noise about them.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The participle keeps the gain in motion - still climbing, where *prosperous* names a state already reached.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Settled rather than surging: comfortable profit as a condition, not a rush.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The loudest word in the set - profit at full volume, and it refuses to be understated.

entries.definition: having achieved success or recognition by your own efforts
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval aimed at the person rather than the outcome, crediting the effort behind the success.

entries.definition: having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The family's flat statement that the outcome went well, carrying none of the swagger *boffo* brings to the same result.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Confidence issued in advance, guaranteeing a success that *made* can already report as done.
examples: a sure-fire way to get rich

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Vitality as the measure of profit, doing well the way a living thing does and with none of *roaring*'s noise.
examples: did a thriving business in orchids

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Smartness with a sharp edge to it - the neatness reads as definition of outline, where *trim* praises proportion.
examples: a clean-cut and well-bred young man

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word of approval for it - nothing out of place, where *orderly* wants an arrangement behind the tidiness.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits the system rather than the surface: things are arranged, not merely unmessy as with *neat*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A quiet yes to tidiness with no appraisal in it, next to the brisk verdict of *shipshape*.

entries.definition: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The briskest approval in the family - order thorough enough that nothing is left to put right, where *neat* is satisfied with the surface.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal, and the tidiness is put on rather than native - a spruced state, where *well-kept* implies it never lapsed.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The bare arrangement word - things put right, with none of the polish *shipshape* claims.

entries.definition: marked by order and cleanliness in appearance or habits
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mild, unemphatic approval that takes in habits as well as appearance, where *clean-cut* is a verdict on looks alone.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Spruce and compact - the same smartness pulled tight, without *clean-cut*'s sharpness of line.
examples: the trig corporal in his jaunty cap

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Here the smartness is one of proportion, nothing loose and nothing spare, where *clean-cut* is about crispness.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves by subtraction, the merit lying in what is gone, where *neat* and *orderly* credit an arrangement.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatter than *uncluttered* - it denies mess rather than paying a compliment for its absence.
examples: the unlittered shoulders of the road

entries.definition: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the keeping as much as the state - the order reads as sustained, where *shipshape* praises how complete it is.

entries.definition: not defended or capable of being defended
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and analytic, looking from the attacker's side at what can be gone after, where *undefended* only reports what is not there.

entries.definition: vulnerable to danger especially of discredit or suspicion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one member whose danger is to standing rather than to body - exposure that invites suspicion and discredit.
examples: she found herself in a compromising situation

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: British spelling, identical in force: helplessness rather than the neutral gap *undefended* reports.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pitying - the subject is helpless and unsupplied, where *undefended* notes only the absence.

entries.definition: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A graded status term rather than a verdict, and the severe end of that grading - extinction imminent, not merely likely.

entries.definition: not able to be protected against attack
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Absolute here: no protection could hold, a harder claim than *undefended*'s report that none is in place.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Treats the exposure as a standing property of the thing's condition, an adverse mark rather than a neutral gap.

entries.definition: not defended or capable of being defended
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The mildest wording for the same state, naming the gap as a plain fact of position rather than the failure *undefendable* implies.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely a property of the barrier - it says what can be got through, with no suggestion that anything is coming through.

entries.definition: (of flora or fauna) likely in the near future to become endangered
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The graded step below *endangered*: likelihood of peril soon rather than peril arrived.
examples: the spotted owl is a threatened species, not yet an endangered one

entries.definition: not defended or capable of being defended
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the weight on impossibility - not that defences are absent but that none could be made to hold.

entries.definition: not defended or capable of being defended
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Bare report of an absence, with no claim that defence was tried or that it could have worked.

entries.definition: subjected to enemy attack or censure
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Shifts from susceptibility to fact - the blows are landing, and they can be censure as readily as weapons.

entries.definition: subjected to enemy attack or censure
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The vivid twin of *under attack*, its gunfire image carrying the same double reach over assault and criticism.
examples: an official under fire for mismanagement

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The blunt everyday form of the same adverse judgement, stating the danger without locating the weakness as *insecure* does.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's flat baseline: it registers that an attack could land without saying anything is missing or anyone is at fault.
